title: add support for insulin Humulin
body: I am a type 2 diabetic currently on glipizide, [Humulin](https://www.humulin.com/insulin-options) 70/30 and when i need it Humulin R.  It would be great if i could add these and see the estimated affects on the xdrip graph.
